items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: finally this Rosenberg, I -- recognized me from something

ctx.x: So, I was sitting there and I left and went back to see if they needed me, so I went back and set down and finally this Rosenberg, I -- recognized me from something, I don't know what. And he told Harry, I saw him whisper to him, and he turned around, so that's when we became friends and he sat down and he said, I gotta play these for you. These are the things that he's taken off the air, the last -- I don't know whatever time we'd been on the air, from Chicago, he knows and here's some -- I made them into solos.…
